title: Shibuya Sky
activityDescription: Watch Tokyo shift from daylight to neon from an open-air observation deck.

title: teamLab Planets
activityDescription: Move through immersive digital installations combining light, water and sound.

title: Tsukiji Food Walk
activityDescription: Sample seafood, tamagoyaki and street snacks through the outer market.

title: Meiji Shrine Morning
activityDescription: Walk through the forested shrine grounds before the busiest part of the day.

title: Akihabara Arcade Trail
activityDescription: Explore retro arcades, electronics stores and character shops as a group.

title: Tokyo DisneySea
activityDescription: Spend a full day exploring DisneySea's themed ports, rides and evening shows.

title: Fushimi Inari Sunrise Walk
activityDescription: Climb through the torii-gate trail early enough to avoid the main crowds.

title: Arashiyama Bamboo Grove
activityDescription: Walk through the bamboo grove and continue toward the riverside district.

title: Kyoto Tea Ceremony
activityDescription: Join a guided tea ceremony introducing the preparation, etiquette and meaning of matcha.

title: Nishiki Market Tasting
activityDescription: Share small tastings while exploring Kyoto's compact covered food market.

title: Kiyomizu-dera and Higashiyama
activityDescription: Visit the hillside temple and explore the preserved streets below it.

title: Gion Evening Walk
activityDescription: Follow a respectful guided route through Gion's historic streets after sunset.

title: Dotonbori Food Night
activityDescription: Build a group tasting route around takoyaki, okonomiyaki and local desserts.

title: Osaka Castle and Park
activityDescription: Explore the castle museum and surrounding park with time for city views.

title: Umeda Sky Building
activityDescription: Take in Osaka's skyline from the rooftop observatory near sunset.

title: Universal Studios Japan
activityDescription: Plan a full park day around the group's preferred rides and timed-entry areas.

title: Shinsaibashi Shopping Walk
activityDescription: Explore the covered shopping arcade and nearby vintage and streetwear stores.

title: Minoh Falls Half-Day
activityDescription: Take a relaxed forest walk to the waterfall on the northern edge of Osaka.
